I recently had the pleasure of moving into my new apartment, and I am absolutely thrilled to share my exceptional experience. From the moment I stepped foot into the building, I knew I had found my perfect haven.

They patiently addressed all my inquiries, provided thorough explanations, and made me feel like a valued resident even before I moved in.

The apartment itself is nothing short of magnificent. The moment I opened the door, I was greeted by an immaculate space that felt like a blank canvas waiting for me to bring it to life. The layout is well-thought-out, maximizing the use of space and providing a sense of openness. The high-quality finishes, modern fixtures, and tasteful design choices create an ambiance of contemporary luxury.

One of the standout features of my new apartment is the attention given to comfort. The temperature control system keeps the environment pleasant throughout the year, ensuring I can always find respite from the elements. The noise insulation is exceptional, creating a serene atmosphere that allows me to relax and unwind after a long day.

The amenities offered in this community are truly second to none. The fitness center is well-equipped with top-of-the-line exercise machines and provides a motivating environment for a great workout. The rooftop terrace, with its breathtaking views, has quickly become my favorite spot to enjoy a cup of coffee while taking in the city skyline. The package delivery system is also a convenient addition, providing peace of mind that my deliveries are safe and secure.

Furthermore, the location of this apartment complex is absolutely ideal. It is situated in a vibrant neighborhood with a wide array of dining options, shops, and entertainment venues within walking distance. Additionally, the proximity to public transportation and major highways makes commuting a breeze.

Last but not least, the maintenance staff deserves a special mention. They are prompt, efficient, and highly skilled. Any concerns or issues I had during the move-in process were resolved quickly and with utmost professionalism. It is reassuring to know that help is just a phone call away.

In conclusion, my move-in experience at this apartment has been nothing short of exceptional. The management team's dedication, the stunning apartment itself, the impressive amenities, the ideal location, and the reliable maintenance service have all contributed to making this my perfect haven. I wholeheartedly recommend this apartment complex to anyone seeking a superior living experience.

reviews.name: Maria Fernanda
reviews.body:
Very satisfied and grateful to have found this place and especially, Edge! Ever since my first day of locating Solo @ North Bergen online, Edge was very responsive and set me up for a same-day tour (even though I had called at around 3pm). The paperwork, moving in, and all associated tasks were seamlessly completed as Edge worked after work hours with me to make sure I could move in that SAME week - specifically 3 days after touring the place!

Ever since moving in towards end of Summer, I have been at the leasing office more times than I can count with several questions. Edge and Cora are always very welcoming and make sure I feel pleased with my move. Edge was even kind enough to help me bring in my hefty furniture pieces from the mail room to my door step as he saw me struggling going back and forth. This was a small act of kindness that truly solidified why I had chose this place as my new home!

The maintenance team is also extremely responsive. I had a problem with one of the towel racks falling in my bathroom --and literally not even 24hrs later-- someone came to help me re-install it. This wasn't even an emergency or something that needed to be done right away, but Edge and the team were super responsive and helped me out as quickly as possible.

Contrary to most, I am liking the new visitor parking policy.. I mean we all pay $$ for a parking spot every month so it was a little upsetting to see the same cars parked for days/weeks+ on the visitor side and having to wonder if they are getting around paying the hefty monthly fee. I tend to have multiple groups of friends come over and hate taking more than 1 visitor parking spot (since there's only a handful) so as a workaround I have allowed one group of friends to park in the actual visitor lot with a visitor pass, then another group to park in MY actual parking spot (with another visible visitor pass so they don't get towed) and I've proceeded to park on the the parallel street of the apartments (48th st - going upwards from Tonnelle Ave) since it is specifically for north Bergen residents. I'm happy I've managed to find these little hacks as it allows me to accommodate 2+ parties of guests and still not take up more than 1 spot at the visitor lot!

Overall, I feel extremely indebted to Edge & the property team for how supportive and helpful they have been since I moved in! Wish I could give this place 5+ stars. Looking forward to continuing my lease here!

response.body: Hi Maria Fernanda, Thank you very much for the wonderful review! We always strive to provide every resident with stellar customer service and a better quality of life in our vibrant community.
